_meta.indication: TROGARZO, in combination with other antiretroviral(s), is indicated for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in heavily treatment-experienced adults with multidrug resistant HIV-1 infection failing their current antiretroviral regimen.

pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3, single-arm, multicenter trial with three periods (Control, Essential Monotherapy, Maintenance), in which subjects served as their own controls; subjects received a 2000 mg loading dose of ibalizumab followed by 800 mg every 2 weeks through Week 23 plus an optimized background regimen (OBR).
pivotal_trials.population: Heavily treatment-experienced adults with multidrug resistant HIV-1, viral load >1,000 copies/mL and documented resistance to at least one antiretroviral from each of three classes (NRTI, NNRTI, and PI).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary efficacy endpoint: proportion of subjects achieving a ≥ 0.5 log10 decrease in viral load at the end of the Essential Monotherapy Period compared to at the end of the Control Period.
pivotal_trials.result: 83% of subjects achieved ≥ 0.5 log10 decrease in viral load at end of Essential Monotherapy Period vs 3% at end of Control Period (p < 0.0001, McNemar's test); at Week 25, 43% had HIV RNA < 50 copies/mL and 50% had HIV RNA < 200 copies/mL.

nct_ctgov.title: Ibalizumab Plus Optimized Background Regimen in Patient With Multi-Drug Resistant HIV

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥ 5%) were diarrhea (8%), dizziness (8%), nausea (5%), and rash (5%); most (90%) reactions were mild or moderate. Serious/severe events included one severe rash and one case of immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS) manifested as exacerbation of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy.
target_moa: CD4-directed post-attachment HIV-1 inhibitor: binds domain 2 of CD4 and interferes with post-attachment steps required for entry of HIV-1 into host cells, preventing viral transmission via cell-cell fusion, without interacting with CD4 domain 1 (important for normal immune function).
modality: mAb (CD4 domain 2-directed humanized IgG4 monoclonal antibody, ~150 kDa)

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee was convened; no issues were identified that would benefit from an Advisory Committee discussion.

description.text: Added intravenous push (IV push) as a new method of administration for the 800 mg maintenance dose

citations.quote: TROGARZO is administered intravenously (IV) as a single loading dose of 2,000 mg followed by a maintenance dose of 800 mg every 2 weeks after dilution in 250 mL of 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP. The TROGARZO maintenance dose can also be administered as an undiluted intravenous push over 30 seconds. (2.1)

summary.text: TROGARZO received Priority Review under BLA 761065 and was approved on the original submission via a rolling review; the program held Fast Track (2003), Orphan Drug (2014), and Breakthrough Therapy (2015) designations. Approval was a standard (non-accelerated) full approval based on the Phase 3 single-arm trial TMB-301.
